description: MAKE a sound effect or ambience that does not exist yet, from a description, as an MP3: a whoosh, a door slam, a cash-register ding, rain on a window, a busy cafe. (find_sound FINDS an existing sound, a meme or trending TikTok sound; this MAKES one.) seconds = length, 0.5-30 (default 5); loop:true for a loopable bed. engine: omit for Seed Audio 1.0 (length and loop are asked for in words, so the length is approximate), or 'eleven-sfx' (ElevenLabs Sound Effects v3: exact length, a real loop flag, description ≤450 characters). Lay it under a video with post_edit (music.track takes its link). dryRun:true returns the exact credits and makes nothing; the price quoted is the charge. Paid, priced by length (hermoso_capabilities -> sound effects).

describe.description: the sound in words: what makes it, where, how it moves, e.g. 'a fast whoosh past the ear' or 'a busy cafe, cups and low murmur'

dryRun.description: true = the exact credits only, nothing made or charged

name: generate_sfx
title: Generate a sound effect
